answer: Oasis escrow admits a key only after it locks jade, and each epoch mirror auditors send every admitted key the same canary prompt at once, grouping keys whose replies match token for token. The k-th key in a group must hold 100k jade, and oasis seizes any shortfall from the group's existing bonds. An honest newcomer locks 100 jade. An operator fielding 100 clones of one model locks 505,000 jade, or it must train a distinct model behind each clone.
